mapper.select: /* isry.itgcms.dyncBrd.mapper.DyncBrdCmnMapper.selectDyncBrdCmnInfoList 공통팀 유민상*/ SELECT NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO , NTABRD_NM , UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , NTABRD_TYPE_SE_CD , RDCNT_INDCT_YN , USE_YN , NTABRD_DSCRP_CN , ATCMFL_SIZEA_MXMM_SZ , BBSCTT_RLS_TYPE_NM , IMPRTN_NTC_YN , CMNT_LMT_CHARAC_CNT , CMNT_INDCT_PRVSON_NM FROM SBA000 WHERE 1=1 AND NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO = #{NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO} AND NVL(DEL_YN, 'N') != 'Y'

/* isry.itgcms.dyncBrd.mapper.DyncBrdCmnMapper.selectDyncBrdCmnColList 공통팀 유민상*/ SELECT NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO , NTABRD_COL_ESNTAL_ID , NTABRD_COL_NM , NTABRD_COL_TYPE_NM , NTABRD_COL_SRTNG_SQNCE , ESNTL_YN , CMMNS_CD_ID , WDTH_MXMM_PLACEM_YN , WDTH_SZ , COL_PLACEM_INFO_CN , DEL_YN , LIST_CONTRO_SIZEA_SZ , NTABRD_TMPT_SE_CD , COL_BASS_VALUE FROM SBA100 WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(DEL_YN, 'N') != 'Y' AND NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO = #{NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO}
ORDER BY NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO, NTABRD_COL_ESNTAL_ID

/* isry.itgcms.dyncBrd.mapper.DyncBrdCmnMapper.selectDyncBrdCmnDtlList 공통팀 유민상*/ SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO , NTC_MATTER_YN , BBSCTT_SN , BBSCTT_TTL_NM , BBSCTT_CN , TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS FRST_REG_DT , RDCNT_NOCS , FRST_RGTR_ID , DEC_B64(SA_FN_GET_NAME(FRST_RGTR_ID)) AS FRST_RGTR_NM , ATFINO , RLS_YN FROM SBA110 WHERE 1=1 AND NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO = #{NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}

/* isry.itgcms.dyncBrd.mapper.DyncBrdCmnMapper.selectDyncBrdCmnColDataList 공통팀 유민상*/ SELECT NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , RETE_ESNTAL_NO , NTABRD_COL_ESNTAL_ID , NTABRD_COL_CN FROM SBA120 WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(DEL_YN, 'N') != 'Y' AND NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO = #{NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}
